definitions.explanation: The cosmetic effect of making skin appear lighter, more even-toned, or more luminous. A major concept in the Japanese beauty and skincare industry, referring to products that reduce spots, freckles, and dullness.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美白効果|びはくこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This toner has a skin-brightening effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビタミン→ビタミン：09770_bitamin⟧C⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美白効果|びはくこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Vitamin C is considered to have strong skin-whitening effects.

examples.japanese: {美白効果|びはくこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{謳|うた}う→謳う：14543_utau⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{医薬部外品|いやくぶがいひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧ (skin whitening/brightening) and ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (effect). ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧ literally means "beautiful white" and is a major marketing and beauty concept in Japan. In the Japanese cosmetics industry, ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧ is officially defined as "preventing melanin production and suppressing spots and freckles" rather than literally bleaching the skin.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fair skin has historically been valued in Japanese aesthetics, reflected in the proverb {色白|いろじろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七難隠|ななんかく}す ("fair skin hides seven flaws"). The modern ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧ industry is enormous, with dedicated product lines from every major cosmetics brand.

- {美白効果|びはくこうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: having a whitening effect
- {美白効果|びはくこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high whitening effect
- {美白効果|びはくこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{期待|きたい}する→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧: to expect a whitening effect
- {美白効果|びはくこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{謳|うた}う→謳う：14543_utau⟧: to advertise a whitening effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧: skin whitening — the concept itself; often used as a modifier
- ⟦{美肌|びはだ}→美肌：14204_bihada⟧: beautiful skin — broader than whitening; includes smoothness, moisture, and overall skin quality
- ⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧: sunscreen — a preventive product that helps maintain fair skin by blocking UV rays
